kpis.explanation: Program aimed at reducing costs and improving operational efficiency.
kpis.description: This program has delivered cumulative annual savings exceeding $150 million through reductions in operational, organizational, and indirect expenses.
kpis.signal: Significant cost reduction to support growth.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Ratio of gross profit to net sales.
kpis.description: Gross margin is an indicator of profitability of products sold, before accounting for other operating expenses.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income relative to net sales.
kpis.description: Operating margin reflects the company's profitability before interest and taxes, indicating the efficiency of its operations.
kpis.signal: Measures profitability of core business activities.

kpis.name: Selling, General and Administrative Expense Ratio
kpis.explanation: Selling, general and administrative expenses as a percentage of net sales.
kpis.description: Selling, general and administrative expenses include marketing, distribution and administrative costs, essential to company management.
kpis.signal: Indicates operational efficiency and trends in overhead expenses.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from the sale of products and services.
kpis.description: Net sales represent total product and service sales before deduction of cost of sales.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net profit after taxes and other expenses.
kpis.description: Net income represents the profit remaining after deduction of all expenses, interest and taxes.

kpis.name: Diluted EPS
kpis.explanation: Net income per ordinary share, adjusted for dilutive effects.
kpis.description: Diluted EPS represents net income divided by the weighted average number of shares outstanding, including dilutive effects.

risks.title: Unstable Global Trade Policy
risks.summary: Changes in U.S. trade policies and tariffs threaten costs, demand, and profitability.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is listed first in the 10-K, with strong language (adverse impact, materially adversely affected). It affects several key areas (costs, demand, cash flow) and is amplified by uncertainty over future tariffs and reimbursements. Geopolitical category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Unpredictable Consumer Demand
risks.summary: Dependence on discretionary spending makes the company vulnerable to economic shifts and changing preferences.
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the document, mentioned in multiple sections with repeated and reinforced language (highly dependent, inherently unpredictable). Direct impact on sales, margin, and DTC strategy. High weighting for demand-related risks.

risks.title: Inaccurate Demand Forecasting
risks.summary: Forecasting errors may lead to costly overstock or stockouts, harming profitability.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is detailed with concrete consequences (overstock, stockouts, margins affected). Strong language (vulnerable, material adverse effect). Linked to internal processes (manual forecasting), increasing its severity. Industrial category moderately weighted.

risks.title: Reliance on External Manufacturers
risks.summary: Outsourced manufacturing poses risks to quality, timing, and availability, affecting delivery and reputation.
risks.score_rationale: Dedicated section in the 10-K with multiple risks (quality, delays, capacity). Concerning language (no assurance, lost sales). Impact on critical supply chain. Industrial category reinforced by geographic concentration in Asia.

risks.title: Raw Material Price Volatility
risks.summary: Instability in prices and availability of raw materials threatens production costs and margins.
risks.score_rationale: Text emphasizes direct impact on costs, margins, and profitability. Mentions inability to absorb price increases. Risk heightened if tariffs apply at raw material origin. Capital category highly relevant.

risks.title: Increased Market Competition
risks.summary: Growing competition from athleisure and emerging brands erodes Columbia's market position.
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly linked to loss of market share and rising pricing pressure. Athleisure and emerging brands capitalize on casualization and style trends. Mentions ongoing competitive pressures in the document.
